index.noPlanTitle: You have no meal plan yet
index.noPlanBody: A plan starts from a calorie and macro target. The Virtual Dietitian can propose one and draft a week from it, or you can set your target yourself first.
index.resolvingBody: Taking you to the week your plan currently covers.

week.title: Your week
week.emptyDay: Nothing planned on this day yet.
week.emptyTitle: Nothing is planned for this week
week.emptyBody: Generate a week from your target, or ask the Virtual Dietitian to draft one. Anything you have kept in an existing week stays where it is.
week.notFoundTitle: That is not a week we can open
week.notFoundBody: A planner week is addressed by a date, written as YYYY-MM-DD. Check the link, or go back to the week you are following.
week.regenerateBody: Every meal you have not kept will be replaced with a different suggestion.
week.regenerateLocksSurvive: Meals you have kept are left exactly where they are. Keeping a meal is a planning choice — it does not record that you ate it, and it never removes anything from your grocery list.
week.actionNotesHint: Your own notes, and any your dietitian has left.
week.actionHistoryHint: Everything that has changed on this plan.
week.actionTemplateHint: Keep this week to start future weeks from.
week.actionDuplicateHint: Copy every meal into a later week.
week.templateTitle: Save this week as a template
week.templateBody: The template keeps the meals, not the notes. You can start a later week from it.
week.duplicateBody: Every meal is copied into the week you choose. Your current week is left alone.
week.warningsBody: {{items}} meals this week contain something you have declared an allergy to: {{meals}}. Replace them, or speak to your dietitian before the week starts.

day.emptyTitle: Nothing is planned for this day
day.emptyBody: Add a food, a recipe, a kitchen meal or a meal you are planning to eat out.
day.notFoundTitle: That is not a day we can open
day.notFoundBody: A planner day is addressed by a date, written as YYYY-MM-DD. Check the link, or go back to your week.
day.regenerateBody: Every meal on this day that you have not kept will be replaced with a different suggestion. The rest of the week is untouched.
day.regenerateLocksSurvive: Meals you have kept stay where they are, and your notes are not affected.
day.warningsBody: {{items}} meals today contain something you have declared an allergy to: {{meals}}.

card.nutritionLine: {{energy}} kcal · protein {{protein}} g · carbs {{carbohydrate}} g · fat {{fat}} g
card.portionHint: 1 is a standard serving. The figures and the cost rescale with it.
card.lockedState: Kept — regeneration will leave this meal in place. This does not record that you ate it.
card.unlockedState: Not kept — regeneration may replace this meal.
card.regenerateHint: Replaces this one meal with another suggestion.
card.regenerateLockedHint: You are keeping this meal. Stop keeping it first.
card.replaceHint: Search meals and recipes, and see what changes before you swap.
card.repeatHint: Copy this meal to another day of the week.
card.repeatBody: The copy goes into the same meal slot on the day you choose.
card.repeatLeftoverLabel: Mark the copy as a leftover
card.repeatLeftoverHint: A leftover is a portion of this meal's yield, so its ingredients are not added to the grocery list a second time.
card.removeHint: Takes this meal out of the day. Nothing else changes.
card.actionErrorBody: Nothing on your plan was changed. Try again in a moment.

warnings.allergenBody: {{meal}} declares {{allergens}}, and you have recorded an allergy. Replace it, or speak to your dietitian before eating it.
warnings.nutritionFallback: {{meal}} sits outside one of your targets for the day.

codes.energy_out_of_range: {{meal}} is a large share of your energy target for the day on its own.
codes.macros_out_of_range: {{meal}} pushes one of your macro targets outside its tolerance for the day.
codes.prohibited_ingredient: {{meal}} contains something you have asked to avoid.
codes.diet_conflict: {{meal}} does not match the way you have said you eat.
codes.over_budget: {{meal}} costs more than the budget you set for a meal.

summary.plannedBasis: These are the figures your plan intends. Nothing here records what you actually ate.
summary.noTargets: You have no nutrition target yet, so there is nothing to compare this against.
summary.noActual: Nothing logged yet — these are planned figures only.
summary.actualPresent: Logged figures are shown separately from planned ones.

cost.allPriced: Every meal here carries a cost estimate.
cost.someUnpriced: {{items}} meals here have no cost estimate, so the total is lower than the real one.

difference.costUnknown: Cost cannot be compared — one of the two has no estimate.
difference.allergensIntroducedTitle: This brings in a new allergen
difference.allergensIntroducedBody: The replacement declares {{allergens}}, which the meal you are replacing does not. Check this against your own allergies before you swap.
difference.allergensRemoved: This removes {{allergens}} compared with the meal you are replacing.
difference.allergensSame: No change to the declared allergens.

replace.title: Choose a replacement
replace.currentBody: {{energy}} kcal, {{protein}} g protein, {{cost}}. Every figure below is compared against this.
replace.searchPlaceholder: A dish, a kitchen or a cuisine
replace.filterAllergensHint: Anything declaring what you pick here is removed from the results.
replace.modeOnceExplanation: Only the meal you opened this from changes.
replace.modeRecurringExplanation: Every later {{mealType}} in this week that is the same meal, and that you are not keeping, changes too.
replace.modeOnceHint: Replacing once changes this meal and nothing else.
replace.modeRecurringHint: Replacing every occurrence changes this meal and every later repeat of it in the week.

reasons.newAllergens: It declares an allergen the meal you are replacing does not.
reasons.otherMealType: It is not usually offered for this meal.
reasons.dayEnergyOutOfRange: It would push the day's energy outside your tolerance.

replace.emptyBody: Widen a range, remove an allergen exclusion, or clear the filters to see everything on offer.
replace.errorTitle: The replacement did not go through
replace.errorBody: Your plan was not changed. Try again in a moment.

add.title: Add to {{day}}
add.gramsHint: In grams. The figures are worked out from this.
add.foodPrompt: Type a food name to search.
add.per100g: {{energy}} kcal and {{protein}} g protein per 100 g
add.perServing: {{energy}} kcal a serving · {{minutes}} min in total
add.noFoodsBody: Try a shorter word, or a more common name for the ingredient.
add.noRecipesBody: Try a shorter word, or clear the search to see everything.
add.noMealsBody: Try a shorter word, or clear the search to see the whole marketplace.
add.restaurantHint: A meal you are planning to eat out. There is no menu behind it, so the figures are a stated estimate rather than a measurement.
add.restaurantDishHint: Optional. Leave it blank and the place's name is used.
add.errorBody: Your plan was not changed. Try again in a moment.

notes.title: Plan notes
notes.customerHint: Only you and any dietitian you have given access to can see these.
notes.neverSaved: You have not saved a note on this plan yet.
notes.noDietitianNote: Your dietitian has not left a note on this plan.
notes.survivesRegeneration: Notes stay in place when you regenerate a meal, a day or the whole week.
notes.errorBody: Your note is still on screen. Try saving it again in a moment.

history.title: Plan history
history.intro: Everything that has changed on this plan, newest first.
history.emptyBody: Every change you make to this plan is recorded here.

grocery.title: Grocery list
grocery.derivationBody: Only the meals you are cooking yourself. A kitchen meal arrives cooked, so it buys nothing, and a leftover is a portion of an earlier meal, so it is never shopped for twice. Keeping a meal in your plan never removes anything from this list.
grocery.localNote: Ticking items off is kept on this device for now and is lost if you reload.
grocery.emptyBody: Nothing in this week is cooked at home, so there is nothing to shop for.
grocery.notFoundTitle: That is not a week we can shop for
grocery.notFoundBody: A grocery list is addressed by the Monday of its week, written as YYYY-MM-DD.
grocery.pantryBody: What you already have. The planner favours recipes that use it, and never treats it as a restriction.
grocery.pantryEmptyBody: Nothing has been recorded in your pantry yet.

recipe.notFoundTitle: We could not find that recipe
recipe.notFoundBody: The link may be wrong, or the recipe may have been removed.
recipe.imageLabel: An illustration standing in for a photograph of {{recipe}}
recipe.portionHint: The ingredient quantities below follow this. What one serving contains does not change.
recipe.portionEnergy: {{energy}} kcal a serving, {{total}} kcal in total
recipe.attribution: Source: {{source}}. Original photography and third-party attribution are not part of this prototype.
recipe.staleTitle: These figures are behind the recipe
recipe.staleBody: The recipe has been edited since these figures were computed, so treat them as an estimate until they are recalculated.
recipe.addDay: It goes onto {{day}}, and you can move it from the planner.
recipe.noPlan: You have no plan to add this to yet. Start one from the planner first.
recipe.addErrorBody: Your plan was not changed. Try again in a moment.

announce.unlocked: {{slot}} no longer kept. {{meal}} may be replaced when you regenerate.
announce.dayRegenerated: {{day}} regenerated. Meals you kept are unchanged.
announce.weekRegenerated: Week regenerated. Meals you kept are unchanged.
announce.duplicated: The week was duplicated into the week of {{week}}.
